model_manager_queue_enabled.label: Show the Queue Tab and its button beside Generate
model_manager_queue_enabled.info: On: a Queue button beside Generate, in txt2img and img2img, keeps the generation as a task, and the Queue tab runs the tasks. Off: the tab and the buttons are hidden at once, and a running queue stops; from the next start neither is created at all. The tasks are kept, and come back when this is on again.
model_manager_queue_enabled.name: Queue Tab
model_manager_queue_enabled.heading: Queue Tab

model_manager_record_generations.label: Record your generations and show the Generations Tab
model_manager_record_generations.info: On: every txt2img and img2img result saved to disk is recorded with all its settings, and shown in the Generations tab and the gallery of each model it used. Off: nothing is recorded, and the Generations tab and each model's Your generations are hidden at once; from the next start the Generations tab is not created at all. What was recorded is kept, and comes back when this is on again.
model_manager_record_generations.name: Generations Tab
model_manager_record_generations.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_gallery_tab.label: Show the Civitai Images Tab
model_manager_gallery_tab.info: On: the Civitai Images tab - the Civitai images stored for the models in your library, in an order its seed picks. Off: the tab is hidden at once and stops, and from the next start it is not created at all.
model_manager_gallery_tab.name: Civitai Images Tab
model_manager_gallery_tab.heading: Civitai Images Tab

model_manager_model_manager_enabled.label: Show the Model Manager Tab
model_manager_model_manager_enabled.info: On: the Model Manager tab - your models, their details and galleries, and the sync with Civitai. Off: the tab is hidden at once and stops, and from the next start it is not created at all; a sync already running finishes. Your library is kept, and downloads still add to it.
model_manager_model_manager_enabled.name: Model Manager Tab
model_manager_model_manager_enabled.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_civitai_browser_enabled.label: Show the Civitai Browser Tab
model_manager_civitai_browser_enabled.info: On: the Civitai Browser tab - searching Civitai, and downloading from it. Off: the tab is hidden at once and stops, and from the next start it is not created at all; downloads already running finish.
model_manager_civitai_browser_enabled.name: Civitai Browser Tab
model_manager_civitai_browser_enabled.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_civitai_api_key.label: Civitai API key
model_manager_civitai_api_key.info: Optional. Gives higher rate limits for requests to Civitai's API.
model_manager_civitai_api_key.name: API key
model_manager_civitai_api_key.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_civitai_requests_per_secon.label: Requests to Civitai per second
model_manager_civitai_requests_per_secon.info: How fast to call Civitai's API when an API key is set. Higher is faster but more likely to be rate limited. Applies to the next search, download or sync; one already running keeps its rate.
model_manager_civitai_requests_per_secon.name: Requests per second
model_manager_civitai_requests_per_secon.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_civitai_images_at_once.label: Civitai images loading at once
model_manager_civitai_images_at_once.info: How many of Civitai's images the galleries load at once; the rest wait until one has loaded, nearest the screen first. Civitai makes resized copies at about 10 to 16 a second and queues the rest, and images asked for hundreds at once failed to load. Not a page size: a page still holds as many images as its tab's setting says.
model_manager_civitai_images_at_once.name: Images loading at once
model_manager_civitai_images_at_once.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_downloads_at_once.label: Downloads running at once
model_manager_downloads_at_once.info: How many downloads run at the same time; the rest wait their turn in the queue. A fast connection may want more; a hard disk, a network drive or a slow connection may want 1. Start now still starts a waiting download over this number. Applies at once: a lower number lets the running downloads finish, and starts no new one until fewer run.
model_manager_downloads_at_once.name: Downloads at once
model_manager_downloads_at_once.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_download_in_parts.label: Download large files in parts
model_manager_download_in_parts.info: Fetches a large file from Civitai over several connections at once, each fetching a part of it. Civitai's storage holds each connection to about 60 MB/s, so a faster line gets large files sooner. Off, every file downloads over one connection, as before. Applies to the next download, and to a paused one when it resumes.
model_manager_download_in_parts.name: Download large files in parts
model_manager_download_in_parts.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_connections_per_file.label: Connections per file, for files downloaded in parts
model_manager_connections_per_file.info: How many connections a large file is fetched over. A part is at least 32 MB, so smaller files use fewer. Applies to the next download, and to a paused one when it resumes.
model_manager_connections_per_file.name: Connections per file
model_manager_connections_per_file.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_civitai_folder_template.label: Folder a download is filed into
model_manager_civitai_folder_template.info: The folder a download is filed into, inside its type's folder. Placeholders: {baseModel}, {modelName}, {creator}, {modelId}.
model_manager_civitai_folder_template.name: Download folder
model_manager_civitai_folder_template.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_card_originals.label: Load model cards' images full size, not resized
model_manager_card_originals.info: Civitai's image server sends a copy the size it is drawn; this asks for the upload instead. Measured on 20 images: a card's copy 54 KB on average, the upload 3.6 MB - 66 times as much. But a copy is usually slower the first time a gallery is opened: Civitai seldom has it ready (1 image in 34, against 15 in 33 uploads, in one test) and takes about half a second to make each. Videos load as copies whatever this says: an upload can be a GIF that cannot play. For the cards of both tabs' grids.
model_manager_card_originals.name: Full-size images on model cards
model_manager_card_originals.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_card_videos_play.label: Play videos on model cards
model_manager_card_videos_play.info: On, a model card whose cover is a video plays it. Off, the card shows the video's still, with a play button in its corner; the video loads only when pressed. Galleries and the viewer are not changed.
model_manager_card_videos_play.name: Play videos on model cards
model_manager_card_videos_play.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_gallery_originals.label: Load gallery images full size, not resized
model_manager_gallery_originals.info: Civitai's image server sends a copy the size it is drawn; this asks for the upload instead. Measured on 20 images: a card's copy 54 KB on average, the upload 3.6 MB - 66 times as much. But a copy is usually slower the first time a gallery is opened: Civitai seldom has it ready (1 image in 34, against 15 in 33 uploads, in one test) and takes about half a second to make each. Videos load as copies whatever this says: an upload can be a GIF that cannot play. The image viewer shows the upload either way. For model galleries and the Civitai Images tab.
model_manager_gallery_originals.name: Full-size images in galleries
model_manager_gallery_originals.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_generations_grid.label: Tiles the Generations Tab keeps on the page
model_manager_generations_grid.info: Either way, tiles load 100 at a time as you scroll toward the end. Only those near the view: keeps on the page only the rows within about 3,000 px of what you see, and draws the others again as they come near; scrolled to the end of 75,685 images, it never froze over 50 ms. All of them: keeps every tile loaded so far on the page, so the browser's find sees them all, but the browser places the whole grid again as each 100 arrive, and the page grows slower the further you scroll - at the end of 75,684 images it froze for up to 42 s at a time.
model_manager_generations_grid.name: Tiles kept on the page
model_manager_generations_grid.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_generations_reading.label: Read Generations Tab tiles in one pass, alpha
model_manager_generations_reading.info: How the Generations tab reads your images for each set of tiles. On: reads them once, into a temporary table in memory, and builds every tile from it - grouped by base model, 75,684 images took 0.28 s instead of 1.47. Off: reads them again for each tile's previews, checkpoint and LoRAs, as before. If tiles look wrong or a level does not load, turn it off and report it.
model_manager_generations_reading.name: Read tiles in one pass
model_manager_generations_reading.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_gallery_grid.label: Tiles the Civitai Images Tab keeps on the page
model_manager_gallery_grid.info: Either way, tiles load 100 at a time as you scroll toward the end. Only those near the view: keeps on the page only the rows within about 3,000 px of what you see, and draws the others again as they come near; scrolled to the end of 75,685 images, it never froze over 50 ms. All of them: keeps every tile loaded so far on the page, so the browser's find sees them all, but the browser places the whole grid again as each 100 arrive, and the page grows slower the further you scroll - at the end of 75,684 images it froze for up to 42 s at a time.
model_manager_gallery_grid.name: Tiles kept on the page
model_manager_gallery_grid.heading: Civitai Images Tab

model_manager_page_size.label: Models per page in the Model Manager Tab
model_manager_page_size.info: How many models a page of the Model Manager shows.
model_manager_page_size.name: Models per page
model_manager_page_size.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_mm_images_per_page.label: Civitai images per page in a model's gallery
model_manager_mm_images_per_page.info: How many images Load More adds in a model's Civitai images - counted before the NSFW and prompt switches.
model_manager_mm_images_per_page.name: Civitai images per page
model_manager_mm_images_per_page.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_mm_generations_per_page.label: Generations per page in a model's Your generations
model_manager_mm_generations_per_page.info: How many generations Load More adds in a model's Your generations. Not used by the Generations tab: it loads as you scroll.
model_manager_mm_generations_per_page.name: Generations per page
model_manager_mm_generations_per_page.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_card_size.label: Card size in the Model Manager Tab
model_manager_card_size.info: The size of the model cards, as width x height in pixels.
model_manager_card_size.name: Card size
model_manager_card_size.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_preview_least_nsfw.label: Use a model's least explicit image as its card's cover
model_manager_preview_least_nsfw.info: On: each card shows the model's least explicit image. Off: its most recent one. Whether galleries hide explicit images is a setting of its own: Hide explicit images by default.
model_manager_preview_least_nsfw.name: Least explicit image as cover
model_manager_preview_least_nsfw.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_civitai_page_size.label: Models per page in the Civitai Browser Tab
model_manager_civitai_page_size.info: How many models a page of the Civitai Browser shows.
model_manager_civitai_page_size.name: Models per page
model_manager_civitai_page_size.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_cb_images_per_page.label: Images per page in the Civitai Browser Tab
model_manager_cb_images_per_page.info: How many images Load More adds in a model's images, fetched from Civitai - counted before the NSFW and prompt switches.
model_manager_cb_images_per_page.name: Images per page
model_manager_cb_images_per_page.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_civitai_card_size.label: Card size in the Civitai Browser Tab
model_manager_civitai_card_size.info: The size of the model cards, as width x height in pixels.
model_manager_civitai_card_size.name: Card size
model_manager_civitai_card_size.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_gallery_hide_nsfw.label: Hide explicit images when a gallery opens
model_manager_gallery_hide_nsfw.info: How Civitai's images open: a model's image gallery, in the Model Manager and the Civitai Browser, and the Civitai Images tab - and a model's Your generations; the Generations tab has its own. The Show NSFW switch above the images shows them there. The Civitai Browser's Include NSFW models decides which models are listed, not which of their images are shown.
model_manager_gallery_hide_nsfw.name: Hide explicit images by default
model_manager_gallery_hide_nsfw.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_nsfw_detection.label: How to find explicit images Civitai rated PG or PG-13
model_manager_nsfw_detection.info: The trained model reads each image's prompts and the resources it used, and catches most of the explicit images Civitai under-rates - but it judges by what it learned, and sometimes raises an image that is fine or misses one that is not. The word list treats an image as X only when its prompt uses one of the words: nothing else, and nothing you cannot check. Stored images are judged again in the background when this changes.
model_manager_nsfw_detection.name: Find explicit PG images with
model_manager_nsfw_detection.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_nsfw_prompt_model_percent.label: Share of PG and PG-13 prompts the trained model treats as X
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_model_percent.info: Civitai rates some explicit images PG or PG-13. A model trained on image prompts - their words, word pairs, negative, ADetailer and hires prompts, and the resources used - finds them, and this is how far it goes: the share of PG and PG-13 prompts it may treat as X, in percent. 2 (default) caught about 94% of X/XXX prompts on a library it had never seen. 1 is stricter, 3 or more catches more at more cost. 0 turns the model off, leaving only the words. Stored images are judged again in the background when this changes.
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_model_percent.name: Share treated as X
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_model_percent.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_nsfw_prompt_words.label: Extra words that mark a prompt explicit
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_words.info: An image Civitai rates PG or PG-13 whose prompt uses one of these words is treated as X everywhere - hidden from the grid previews, the galleries and the SFW filters. Whole words, any case. These add to the list that comes with the extension, in model_manager/data/nsfw_prompt_words.txt. Stored images are judged again in the background when this changes.
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_words.name: Extra NSFW words
model_manager_nsfw_prompt_words.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_hide_promptless_images.label: Hide images with no prompt when a gallery opens
model_manager_hide_promptless_images.info: About a tenth of Civitai's images carry no prompt at all, and they cannot be read or reused. Can be turned back on per model from the panel above the images. Model galleries only, in the Model Manager and the Civitai Browser: the Civitai Images tab shows every image.
model_manager_hide_promptless_images.name: Hide images with no prompt by default
model_manager_hide_promptless_images.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_generations_hide_nsfw.label: Hide explicit images when the Generations Tab opens
model_manager_generations_hide_nsfw.info: How the Generations tab opens. The Show NSFW switch above the images shows them until the tab is opened again. A model's Your generations, in the Model Manager, follows the other Hide explicit images by default, in Shared across tabs.
model_manager_generations_hide_nsfw.name: Hide explicit images by default
model_manager_generations_hide_nsfw.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_civitai_min_prompt_images.label: Images with a usable prompt a model needs to be shown
model_manager_civitai_min_prompt_images.info: For the Only with usable prompts filter: a model must have at least this many images, of its first 20, carrying a prompt and its steps, sampler and CFG.
model_manager_civitai_min_prompt_images.name: Images with a prompt a model needs
model_manager_civitai_min_prompt_images.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_civitai_sfw_fill_page.label: Fill each page while only SFW models show, not recommended
model_manager_civitai_sfw_fill_page.info: Normally a page with Only Show Models with SFW images stops after checking a few dozen models and can come back short. With this on, it keeps searching until the page holds the full Models per page. Most Civitai models have NSFW images, so one page can take hundreds of requests and several minutes, and makes Civitai's rate limit likely. A page still stops if Civitai starts refusing requests.
model_manager_civitai_sfw_fill_page.name: Fill pages while hiding NSFW models
model_manager_civitai_sfw_fill_page.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_civitai_on_site_marks.label: Mark versions Civitai allows only on its site
model_manager_civitai_on_site_marks.info: Marks the versions whose creator allows them only for generating on Civitai - Civitai refuses their download - on the cards and in a model's panel. Asks Civitai once per page and once per model opened; its answer is often under a megabyte, and can be a few. The Model Manager marks them whatever this says, from what a sync stored.
model_manager_civitai_on_site_marks.name: Mark on-site-only versions
model_manager_civitai_on_site_marks.heading: Civitai Browser Tab

model_manager_send_clip_skip.label: Send uses the image's Clip skip
model_manager_send_clip_skip.info: On: where an image gives a clip skip other than your Clip Skip setting, Send adds it to the tab's Override settings, and says so - so the image can be made again as it was. It applies to the generations made while it is there; your setting is not changed, and the next Send replaces it. Not for Flux, where clip skip changes nothing. Off: left to Forge's paste, which in Forge Neo ignores it.
model_manager_send_clip_skip.name: Use the image's Clip skip
model_manager_send_clip_skip.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_send_clip_skip_max.label: Highest Clip skip Send takes from an image
model_manager_send_clip_skip_max.info: An image's clip skip above this is left out of Override settings, and your Clip Skip applies; Send's notice says so. Most models are made for 1 or 2.
model_manager_send_clip_skip_max.name: Highest Clip skip
model_manager_send_clip_skip_max.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_flux.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Flux.1 / Chroma
model_manager_modules_flux.info: Flux.1 and Flux.1 Schnell need CLIP-L, T5-XXL and Flux VAE (ae); Chroma needs T5-XXL and Flux VAE (ae). Download: clip_l, t5xxl fp16, t5xxl fp8, ae
model_manager_modules_flux.name: Flux.1 / Chroma text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_flux.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_klein.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Flux.2 Klein
model_manager_modules_klein.info: Klein 4B needs Qwen3 4B and Flux.2 VAE; Klein 9B needs Qwen3 8B and Flux.2 VAE. Download: qwen_3_4b, qwen3_4b fp8, flux2-vae, qwen_3_8b, qwen_3_8b fp8
model_manager_modules_klein.name: Flux.2 Klein text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_klein.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_lumina.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Lumina Image 2.0
model_manager_modules_lumina.info: Needs Gemma 2 2B and Flux VAE (ae). Download: gemma_2_2b, ae
model_manager_modules_lumina.name: Lumina Image 2.0 text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_lumina.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_zit.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Z-Image
model_manager_modules_zit.info: Needs Qwen3 4B and Flux VAE (ae). Download: qwen_3_4b, qwen3_4b fp8, ae
model_manager_modules_zit.name: Z-Image text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_zit.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_anima.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Anima
model_manager_modules_anima.info: Needs Qwen3 0.6B and Qwen-Image VAE. Download: qwen_3_06b_base, qwen_image_vae
model_manager_modules_anima.name: Anima text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_anima.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_wan.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Wan
model_manager_modules_wan.info: Needs UMT5-XXL and Wan 2.1 VAE. UMT5-XXL loads only in the Hugging Face layout these links have. Download: umt5_xxl fp16, umt5_xxl fp8, wan_2.1_vae
model_manager_modules_wan.name: Wan text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_wan.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_qwen.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Qwen-Image
model_manager_modules_qwen.info: Needs Qwen2.5-VL 7B and Qwen-Image VAE. Download: qwen_2.5_vl_7b fp16, qwen_2.5_vl_7b fp8, qwen_image_vae
model_manager_modules_qwen.name: Qwen-Image text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_qwen.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_krea.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for Krea 2
model_manager_modules_krea.info: Needs Qwen3-VL 4B and Qwen-Image VAE. Download: qwen3vl_4b bf16, qwen3vl_4b fp8, qwen_image_vae
model_manager_modules_krea.name: Krea 2 text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_krea.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_ernie.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for ERNIE-Image
model_manager_modules_ernie.info: Needs Ministral 3 3B and Flux.2 VAE. Download: ministral-3-3b, flux2-vae
model_manager_modules_ernie.name: ERNIE-Image text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_ernie.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_modules_pid.label: Text encoders and VAE Send picks for PiD
model_manager_modules_pid.info: Needs Gemma 2 2B IT. Its VAE depends on the model, and is left to you. Download: gemma_2_2b_it bf16, gemma_2_2b_it fp8
model_manager_modules_pid.name: PiD text encoders and VAE
model_manager_modules_pid.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_generations_delete_files.label: Tick "also delete the image files" when deleting generations
model_manager_generations_delete_files.info: Ticks the box in the delete question. It can still be unticked for one delete.
model_manager_generations_delete_files.name: Tick "also delete the files"
model_manager_generations_delete_files.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_generations_keep_inputs.label: Keep the image and mask an img2img generation started from
model_manager_generations_keep_inputs.info: On: each img2img generation recorded keeps the picture in its mode's canvas and what was painted over it - the mask, or the strokes - so Send puts them back and the viewer shows them. One file per picture, however many generations started from it, deleted with the last of them. Off: nothing more is kept; what was kept stays.
model_manager_generations_keep_inputs.name: Keep img2img start images
model_manager_generations_keep_inputs.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_image_sync_level.label: NSFW level Sync images gives images without infotext
model_manager_image_sync_level.info: What the Sync images dialog starts from. The level picked there is given to the images without infotext that sync brings, and kept with them. A rating you give an image wins.
model_manager_image_sync_level.name: NSFW level for images without infotext
model_manager_image_sync_level.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_group_no_text.label: Sync images groups images without infotext by file name
model_manager_group_no_text.info: What the Sync images dialog starts from. Images in one folder whose file names say the same settings, saved close together, become one batch, as one press of Generate made them.
model_manager_group_no_text.name: Group images without infotext by name
model_manager_group_no_text.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_database_path.label: Database file, needs a restart
model_manager_database_path.info: Full path to the database file, with its name. Empty: the default, in the extension's folder. Two WebUIs can share one.
model_manager_database_path.name: Database file
model_manager_database_path.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_thumbnails.label: Make thumbnails of your generations
model_manager_thumbnails.info: Ticks Make thumbnails in the Sync images dialog, and makes one for each image you generate. A sync with it ticked makes one for every image without one. Tiles then load a small copy, 450 pixels tall, instead of the full file; the viewer still shows the full file. An image without one shows its full file.
model_manager_thumbnails.name: Make thumbnails
model_manager_thumbnails.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_thumbnails_place.label: Where thumbnails of your generations are kept
model_manager_thumbnails_place.info: In a folder: the Thumbnail folder below. Beside each image: in a .thumbnails folder next to it, which Sync images skips. A change applies to thumbnails made from then on; those made before keep working where they are.
model_manager_thumbnails_place.name: Where thumbnails are kept
model_manager_thumbnails_place.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_thumbnails_folder.label: Folder for thumbnails, when kept in one
model_manager_thumbnails_folder.info: Its full path. Empty: a folder named thumbnails beside the database, which two WebUIs sharing the database share too. Deleting it is safe: a sync makes them again.
model_manager_thumbnails_folder.placeholder: Empty: a thumbnails folder beside the database
model_manager_thumbnails_folder.name: Thumbnail folder
model_manager_thumbnails_folder.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_thumbnail_threads.label: Thumbnails made at once
model_manager_thumbnail_threads.info: 0: as many as the machine has processors - making one is mostly processor work. Lower it for a hard disk or a network drive, or to keep the machine free while a sync makes them.
model_manager_thumbnail_threads.name: Thumbnails made at once
model_manager_thumbnail_threads.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_queue_inputs_dir.label: Folder for the images queued tasks need
model_manager_queue_inputs_dir.info: A queued task keeps the images it was given here - an img2img source and mask, ControlNet's images - until it is deleted, one folder per task. Empty: queue-inputs in the WebUI's folder, beside outputs. Tasks keep their files' full paths, so a change applies to tasks queued after it.
model_manager_queue_inputs_dir.name: Folder for queued tasks' images
model_manager_queue_inputs_dir.heading: Queue Tab

model_manager_generations_inputs_dir.label: Folder for the images img2img generations started from
model_manager_generations_inputs_dir.info: Its full path. Empty: a folder named generation-inputs beside the database, which two WebUIs sharing the database share too. Generations keep their files' full paths, so a change applies to generations recorded after it.
model_manager_generations_inputs_dir.placeholder: Empty: a generation-inputs folder beside the database
model_manager_generations_inputs_dir.name: Folder for start images
model_manager_generations_inputs_dir.heading: Generations Tab

model_manager_queue_ask_above.label: Ask before Generate makes more than this many images
model_manager_queue_ask_above.info: Batch count times batch size. Above it, Generate asks whether to generate, queue it instead, or cancel; the question can be turned off in each browser. 0: Generate never asks.
model_manager_queue_ask_above.name: Ask before generating more than
model_manager_queue_ask_above.heading: Queue Tab

model_manager_hash_threads.label: Files a sync hashes at once
model_manager_hash_threads.info: How many model files to hash at once when a sync identifies them. Each file is read in full, so the drive usually sets the pace. Hard disk or network drive: 1-2 - more make it slower. SATA SSD: 2-4. NVMe: 4-8, or more on a CPU with many cores. Lower it if a sync makes the machine slow.
model_manager_hash_threads.name: Files hashed at once
model_manager_hash_threads.heading: Model Manager Tab

model_manager_sync_images_per_version.label: Civitai images a sync keeps per version
model_manager_sync_images_per_version.info: How many of each version's Civitai images a sync fetches and keeps - from the sync dialog, a model's Sync, a download. The dialog's "First N images" is this number. A model's NSFW level counts its worst stored image, and the Civitai Images tab shows stored images only: fewer kept, less to judge and show.
model_manager_sync_images_per_version.name: Images kept per version
model_manager_sync_images_per_version.heading: Shared across tabs

model_manager_check_updates.label: Check for a new version of the Model Manager
model_manager_check_updates.info: On: after the WebUI starts, and every 12 hours, the extension reads the version.json file on its GitHub repository - the version it holds, nothing else - and each tab's header says when a newer one is out. Off: GitHub is never asked.
model_manager_check_updates.name: Check for a new version
model_manager_check_updates.heading: Shared across tabs
